name: Gods Appearance
overview: Scripture reveals that God's appearance is both majestic and symbolic, reflecting His divine nature rather than a physical form fully comprehensible to man. While Ezekiel and Daniel describe visions of God with human-like features and radiant garments, the creation of man in God's image (Genesis 1:27) highlights a unique reflection of God's character rather than His literal appearance. Furthermore, true beauty and righteousness are inward qualities rooted in reverence for the Lord, as Proverbs 31:30 and Matthew 23:28 emphasize the contrast between outward appearance and inner reality.
